svg.title: Mutex vs Semaphore comparison
svg.desc: Left side shows a mutex as a single-slot lock where only the owner thread can unlock. Right side shows a semaphore as a counter allowing N threads into a pool of resources simultaneously.
svg.text: শুধু Thread A unlock করতে পারে (owner)
যেকোনো thread signal করতে পারে (কোনো ownership নেই)
